mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_PW, MEMBER_NICKNAME, MEMBER_TEL, ENROLL_DATE, MEMBER_DEL_FL FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_PW, MEMBER_NICKNAME, MEMBER_DEL_FL , MEMBER_TEL ) VALUES ( #{memberEmail}, #{memberPw}, #{memberNickname}, 'N' , #{memberTel} )
